paper_title: A Search for Invisible Axion Dark Matter with the Axion Dark Matter Experiment
notes: ADMX haloscope excludes DFSZ axion-photon coupling over 645-680 MHz (2.66-2.81 ueV). The 90% CL exclusion reaches DFSZ coupling (g_agamma ~ 5e-16 GeV^-1 in this mass range). Exact numerical limit values vs mass are only available from Fig. 4 which is not machine-readable; data_points are approximate estimates at DFSZ level. Density assumed 0.45 GeV/cm^3 for Maxwellian model (0.63 for N-body).
